title: Fix leaderboard weekly/monthly timeframe filtering to use integer day comparisons

requirements.text: Update backend leaderboard timeframe filtering so the Weekly and Monthly filters return only results inside the intended day windows by comparing integer day IDs (the same day IDs used when recording results) instead of comparing nanosecond timestamps.

quotes: Why is it still not filtering correctly? Its still giving me all time results instead of weekly and monthly
I tested this for both monthly and weekly and went well past 7 and 30 days

acceptanceCriteria: When requesting the leaderboard with timeFilter="weekly", only daily logs whose day ID is within the last 7 days (inclusive) of the current day are included in each user’s aggregated stats.
When requesting the leaderboard with timeFilter="monthly", only daily logs whose day ID is within the last 30 days (inclusive) of the current day are included in each user’s aggregated stats.
When requesting the leaderboard with timeFilter="all", all available daily logs are included (no timeframe restriction).
The returned leaderboard ordering and each user’s wins/losses/totalGames/streak/score reflect only the logs included by the selected timeframe (not all-time totals).
The fix applies consistently to all backend leaderboard endpoints that accept a timeframe (e.g., getLeaderboard and getTopPlayersByScore), so they cannot disagree for the same timeframe.

requirements.text: Ensure recording and removing results (recordDailyWin/recordDailyLoss/decrementDailyLog) continue to work without requiring any data migration, and the corrected timeframe filtering works immediately for existing stored daily logs.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing daily logs stored before this change remain readable and do not cause traps after upgrade.
After recording a win/loss for a day that is outside the weekly/monthly windows, that result does not appear in weekly/monthly leaderboards but does appear in the all-time leaderboard.
After removing (decrementing) wins/losses for a day, the leaderboard updates correctly for all three filters based on the day’s inclusion/exclusion in the timeframe window.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo (no new backend services).
Do not change the user flow for selecting a date and recording/removing wins/losses in the frontend.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them only).
nonGoals: Adding new timeframe options beyond Weekly/Monthly/All Time.
Introducing or integrating any external database or analytics service.
